snippet.title: Square Force Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 THE 3-PLAYER SQUARE FORCE DEMO IS AVAILABLE RIGHT NOW ON STEAM! 🔥

Grab two friends, load up, and see how long you can survive the chaos.

Square Force is a fast, brutal co-op survival shooter where every phase gets harder, enemies get stronger, and taking too long can turn a bad situation into an absolute nightmare.

Fight through escalating hordes, upgrade your weapons, hunt down the portal combination, escape to the next phase, and prepare yourself for the boss waiting at the end.

This trailer showcases the complete Square Force experience. The currently available Steam Demo supports up to 3 players and gives you a taste of the insanity waiting in the full game.

💥 Fight increasingly massive hordes
🔫 Upgrade and improve your weapons
🌀 Find the portal combination and escape
☠️ Survive increasingly dangerous phases
👹 Battle massive bosses
🤝 Bring friends. Make questionable decisions. Try not to die.

RUN. SHOOT. SWEAR. REPEAT.

🎮 Play the 3-player demo FREE on Steam right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4299040/Square_Force/

Wishlist Square Force and follow Creekside Interactive for more updates!

#SquareForce #IndieGame #IndieDev #GameDev #CoopGames #FPS #SurvivalGame #SteamGames #PCGaming #Gaming
